galatians.5.p1.b1.text: It is for freedom that Christ has set us free. Stand firm, then, and do not be encumbered once more by a yoke of slavery.

galatians.5.p1.b2.text: Take notice: I, Paul, tell you that if you let yourselves be circumcised, Christ will be of no value to you at all.

galatians.5.p2.b1.text: You who are trying to be justified by the law have been severed from Christ; you have fallen away from grace.

galatians.5.p2.b2.text: But by faith we eagerly await through the Spirit the hope of righteousness.

galatians.5.p2.b3.text: … All that matters is faith, expressed through love.

galatians.5.p3.b1.text: You were running so well. Who has obstructed you from obeying the truth?

galatians.5.p3.b2.text: A little leaven works through the whole batch of dough.

galatians.5.p3.b3.text: … The one who is troubling you will bear the judgment, whoever he may be.

galatians.5.p4.b1.text: Now, brothers, if I am still preaching circumcision, why am I still being persecuted?

galatians.5.p4.b2.text: As for those who are agitating you, I wish they would proceed to emasculate themselves!

galatians.5.p4.b3.text: … do not use your freedom as an opportunity for the flesh. Rather, serve one another in love.

galatians.5.p4.b4.text: The entire law is fulfilled in a single decree: “Love your neighbor as yourself.”

galatians.5.p5.b1.text: So I say, walk by the Spirit, and you will not gratify the desires of the flesh.

galatians.5.p5.b2.text: The acts of the flesh are obvious … those who practice such things will not inherit the kingdom of God.

galatians.5.p5.b3.text: I warn you, as I did before …
